summary.en: Supports the wage rule and requests application to all existing H-1B holders.

summary.zh: 要求撤回，认为突然上调会破坏既有员工续签及PERM安排并使雇主失去熟练员工。
summary.en: Requests withdrawal, arguing abrupt increases disrupt existing workers’ extensions and PERM plans and cost employers experienced staff.

summary.zh: 认为上调会削减小企业初级招聘、拖慢创新，并让招聘机会向大企业集中。
summary.en: Argues increases reduce small firms’ junior hiring, slow innovation, and concentrate opportunities in large employers.

summary.zh: 明确反对，认为不公平且损害勤劳员工，未进一步说明机制。
summary.en: Explicitly opposes the proposal as unfair and harmful to hardworking people, without further explanation.

summary.zh: 仅有含糊的改善表述，无法判断对提案的立场。
summary.en: Provides only a vague reference to improvement, insufficient to determine a stance on the proposal.

summary.zh: 明确支持最终实施，并要求更高工资倍数、限于第四级及加强招聘核查和执法。
summary.en: Explicitly supports finalization and seeks higher wage multipliers, Level IV-only certification, recruitment checks, and enforcement.

sourceNote.zh: 官方附件下载返回 403；保留该随机样本，仅按可读正文分类，正文不足则列为无法判断。
sourceNote.en: Official attachment downloads returned 403. The sampled record is retained and classified only from readable body text; insufficient text is unclassifiable.

summary.zh: 认为第34百分位不足，建议H-1B依赖雇主的入门底线改为第52百分位，并禁止降级转职。
summary.en: Finds the 34th percentile insufficient, proposing the 52nd for H-1B-dependent employers and prohibiting moves to lower wage levels.

description.zh: 评论对工资百分位、经验层级和地区适配性的看法。
description.en: Views on wage percentiles, experience tiers, and regional fit.

description.zh: 入门岗位、培训和职业发展机会。
description.en: Entry-level hiring, training, and career progression.

description.zh: 初创企业、中小雇主的成本及大型企业优势。
description.en: Costs for startups and smaller employers and advantages for large firms.

description.zh: 人才留存、创新、国内就业及工作外迁的预期影响。
description.en: Expected effects on talent retention, innovation, domestic jobs, and offshoring.

description.zh: 高校、研究机构及公共服务雇主的工资和预算结构。
description.en: Pay and funding structures of universities, research, and public-service employers.

description.zh: 对工资压低、劳工替代及公平竞争的关注；指控不视为已证实。
description.en: Concerns about underpayment, displacement, and fair competition; allegations are not verified findings.

description.zh: 审计、分类、招聘、流动性或签证制度的其他建议。
description.en: Audits, classification, recruitment, portability, and other visa-system recommendations.

description.zh: 法律和程序异议，以及既有案件、实施节奏和可预期性。
description.en: Legal and procedural objections, existing cases, implementation timing, and predictability.

scopeNote.zh: 提案涉及H-1B、H-1B1、E-3及PERM工资确定；部分评论讨论另行制定的H-1B选取机制。
scopeNote.en: The proposal covers wage determinations for H-1B, H-1B1, E-3, and PERM; some comments discuss a separate H-1B selection policy.
